steps.name: Given the company actor is signed in for file uploads
And signed-url uploads are available to this actor
When the company requests a signed URL for file:
Then soft assert signed URL response status is 200
And soft assert response contains uploadUrl

And soft assert response contains publicUrl

signed-url response should contain publicUrl; body: {"uploadUrl":"/api/dev-lite/upload/b93530aa-54c1-4100-ac1b-c54152c5a9b5","publicUrl":"/api/dev-lite/files/content/E2ECOMPANY1792133542665/1792133542720_test-profile.jpg","filePath":"content/E2ECOMPANY1792133542665/1792133542720_test-profile.jpg","expiresAt":"2026-10-16T06:57:22.720990173Z","uploadId
And soft assert response contains uploadId

signed-url response should contain uploadId; body: {"uploadUrl":"/api/dev-lite/upload/b93530aa-54c1-4100-ac1b-c54152c5a9b5","publicUrl":"/api/dev-lite/files/content/E2ECOMPANY1792133542665/1792133542720_test-profile.jpg","filePath":"content/E2ECOMPANY1792133542665/1792133542720_test-profile.jpg","expiresAt":"2026-10-16T06:57:22.720990173Z","uploadId
And soft assert uploadUrl starts with "https://storage.googleapis.com"
uploadUrl should be a https://storage.googleapis.com signed URL, or the dev-lite sink /api/dev-lite/upload/<uuid> — got "/api/dev-lite/upload/b93530aa-54c1-4100-ac1b-c54152c5a9b5"
When the company uploads test image (500KB) to the signed URL using PUT
Then soft assert Firebase upload response is success (200-299)
Firebase upload should succeed (200-299), got 200; body:
When the company confirms upload with uploadId and filePath
Then soft assert confirm response status is 200
When the company sets their profilePicture to the uploaded public URL
Then soft assert profile update status is 200
And soft assert GET /users/me shows the new profilePicture URL
profilePicture should match the uploaded publicUrl
